content:
For IVX, your goal should be to establish a permanent process where every deployment automatically runs:

Source code audit
Security audit
Authentication audit
Database audit
API audit
IVX IA Chat audit
Autonomous Developer audit
Enterprise module audit
Mobile QA (Android, iOS, Web)
Performance tests
Regression tests
Disaster recovery verification
Production health checks
Owner Dashboard verification
Member/Investor verification
Monitoring and alert verification
